summary: Tested per-client public application links (/<slug>/apply). Backend: 22 pytest cases (X-Tenant-Slug binding on courses/colleges/referrer/applications, unknown slug 404, suspended 403, no-header default, case-insensitive slug, /auth/me tenant_slug, owner PATCH slug slugify/reserved/short/409 duplicate, tenant admin forbidden, cross-tenant isolation using a temporary second tenant). 21/22 pass; one minor bug: an all-symbol slug like '!!' becomes 'company' and is saved (200) instead of being rejected. Frontend: /zelix-ventures/apply?ref=suhail shows the company logo and name, the brand colour (#dd2424) on buttons and the referrer banner (Suhail, auto-tagged). A full 5-step submission sent X-Tenant-Slug=zelix-ventures and created the student in ZELIX VENTURES with reference=Suhail; the test student was deleted afterwards. /nope-co/apply shows apply-invalid-link. In the Platform Console, the client Overview has all client-apply-link controls. Changing the slug to zelix-test-link updated the URL; 'platform' returned 400 and showed the 'Didn't go through' error dialog; 'ab' disables Save; Copy works; slug restored to zelix-ventures. As tenant admin, Students 'Share application link' copies <origin>/zelix-ventures/apply and ClientDetail 'Copy referral link' copies <origin>/zelix-ventures/apply?ref=suhail. Temporary tenant deleted; only ZELIX VENTURES remains.

minor.issue: lib/whitelabel.slugify() returns 'company' when the input has no letters or digits, so slug '!!' is saved as 'company' (200) instead of returning 400. Fix: in update_tenant use a slugify that does not fall back (e.g. routers/applications.slugify), or reject the raw input when it slugifies to empty.
Auto-generated slugs on company creation do not check RESERVED_SLUGS, so a company named 'Admin', 'Login' or 'Platform' gets a reserved slug. Add the reserved check and a suffix in unique_slug.

ui_bugs.issue: document.title stays 'EduConnect Pro' even though /api/branding?tenant=zelix-ventures returns app_name 'ZELIX VENTURES'. The 'Apply · <app_name>' title is probably overwritten by the global branding/title effect.

issues: Date of Birth uses the browser's native date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: Reject slugs that slugify to empty in PATCH /platform/tenants/{id} (currently becomes 'company')
Make unique_slug skip RESERVED_SLUGS when creating a tenant
(Low) Make the branded apply page tab title show the company app_name
(Optional) Old links break with no redirect after the owner renames a slug; consider keeping previous slugs as aliases
critical_code_review_comments: bind_public_tenant is async, so set_current_tenant runs in the request context and binds the tenant correctly (confirmed by the isolation test). Keep it async: a sync dependency runs in the threadpool and would lose the ContextVar.
platform.update_tenant imports slugify from lib/whitelabel, which falls back to 'company'. Two different slugify functions exist (whitelabel and applications.py) with different fallback behaviour.
After the owner renames a slug, a logged-in tenant admin keeps the old slug in memory (setApplyTenantSlug from /auth/me) until the profile refreshes, so links they share in that window are dead.
Referral attribution in the public submission is stored only in the reference name ('Suhail'); referrer_user_id stays null for associate-type clients. This is existing behaviour, not a regression.
seed_data_creation: Temporary tenant 'TEST Isolation Co' created and deleted by the pytest fixture. One UI test student 'TEST_Zelix UI Student' created and deleted. Zelix slug restored to zelix-ventures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit on public submit is 5/hour per IP; this run used 2 (1 pytest isolation submit, 1 UI). Zelix tenant id 3b5e3f1f-dba9-4a89-a201-c2fdb24372ef; Suhail client id 0da9c167-0a01-4833-9b46-fb87eb52e306. The public form has 5 steps (Payment & Reference combined). Platform console errors appear in a custom 'Didn't go through' dialog, not a sonner toast. The topbar public-form link only renders when REACT_APP_APPLY_PUBLIC_URL is set (it is not set).
